title: University of Cebu grad tops naval architects computer-based licensure exam
summary: A graduate of the University of Cebu achieved the top score in the computer-based licensure examination for naval architects given earlier this month.

blocks.text: A graduate of the University of Cebu achieved the top score in the computer-based licensure examination for naval architects given earlier this month.
According to the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), 48 out of 159 test takers passed the exam, given by the Board of Naval Architecture at test centers in Metro Manila and Cebu.
King Jos Rydan Solon Relatorres of the University of Cebu was the top scorer with a result of 85.30%.
